# Catalyst Labs

> Apify Actors (APIs and MCP tools) for AI agents: job listings from ATS career sites, website screenshots/PDFs, YouTube transcripts.

## Tools
- [YouTube Transcript API for AI Agents (MCP, JSON, SRT)](https://catalyst-labs-dev.github.io/guides/youtube-transcript-api-for-ai-agents.html): How to give an AI agent YouTube transcripts with timestamps via an MCP server or REST API: videos, Shorts, channels, playlists and search. Store: https://apify.com/catalyst-labs/youtube-transcript-api MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/youtube-transcript-api
- [How to Scrape Greenhouse, Lever and Workday Jobs as JSON](https://catalyst-labs-dev.github.io/guides/scrape-greenhouse-lever-workday-jobs.html): Get live job listings from Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby and 13 more ATS career sites in one normalized JSON schema. Store: https://apify.com/catalyst-labs/career-site-jobs-scraper MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/career-site-jobs-scraper
- [Website Screenshot & PDF API: Full-Page PNG and PDF from Any URL](https://catalyst-labs-dev.github.io/guides/website-screenshot-pdf-api.html): Turn a URL into a full-page PNG, JPEG, WebP screenshot or PDF with cookie banners removed and lazy images loaded. API and MCP examples. Store: https://apify.com/catalyst-labs/website-screenshot-pdf-api MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/website-screenshot-pdf-api


## YouTube Transcript API for AI Agents (MCP, JSON, SRT)

AI agents often need the words spoken in a video: to summarise it, research a competitor channel or answer questions. Our YouTube Transcript API on Apify returns transcripts with timestamps plus video metadata as JSON, SRT, VTT, plain text or Markdown.
Option 1: connect it to an agent over MCP
Add this MCP server URL to Claude, Cursor or any MCP client (Apify token required):
https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/youtube-transcript-api
The agent gets one tool that takes video, Shorts, playlist, channel or search inputs.
Option 2: call the REST API
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/catalyst-labs~youtube-transcript-api/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=$APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"startUrls":["https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ"]}'
Check the input tab on the Store page for the exact field names and options.
What you getTimestamped segments plus full text, with auto-generated vs human captions flaggedLanguage choice and a free check of which caption languages existChannel monitoring that only returns new videos, with date filtersYou pay only for transcripts delivered: $0.005 per run + $0.008 per transcript on the Free plan, lower on higher tiers
LimitsVideos with no captions return no transcript (and aren't charged).

## How to Scrape Greenhouse, Lever and Workday Jobs as JSON

Most companies post jobs on an applicant tracking system (ATS) such as Greenhouse, Lever, Workday or Ashby. Each one has a different page layout and API. Our Career Site Jobs Scraper reads 17 ATS platforms and returns one schema: title, location, remote flag, salary, seniority and apply URL.
InputGive it company names (it finds the career site) or careers/job-board URLs, such as https://boards.greenhouse.io/<company>, https://jobs.lever.co/<company> or a myworkdayjobs.com link.
Over MCP for AI agentshttps://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/career-site-jobs-scraper
Useful featuresKeyword, location, remote-only, posted-since and salary filtersMonitoring mode that reports new and closed jobs since the last runErrors, not-found companies and duplicates are not charged
Tested numbersIn our Oct 2026 QA, 52 of 52 per-platform cloud cases passed across 17 platforms. NVIDIA, Bosch and JPMorgan Chase boards together (15,057 jobs) came back in 45 seconds with 0 duplicates, and 745 sampled records had 0 schema violations.
LimitsName auto-detection can pick a different company that shares the same name (2 of 20 in testing). Pass the careers URL for those.

## Website Screenshot & PDF API: Full-Page PNG and PDF from Any URL

Our Website Screenshot & PDF API captures full-page screenshots (PNG, JPEG, WebP) and PDFs of any URL, with desktop, tablet and mobile presets.
Call it from codecurl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/catalyst-labs~website-screenshot-pdf-api/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=$APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"urls":["https://example.com"]}'
See the Store page input tab for exact field names (format, device, PDF options, fast mode).
For AI agents (MCP)https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=catalyst-labs/website-screenshot-pdf-api
What it handlesRemoves cookie banners and fixes sticky headersScrolls to load lazy imagesRenders emoji and CJK textYou pay only for successful captures
How we testedIn an Oct 18, 2026 benchmark we ran the same 12 URLs, at the same settings, through ours and five other Store screenshot tools, including the most-used one. Pages with heavy animation can still need tweaking; we publish where we lost, not only where we won.
